mapper.sql: INNER JOIN sample ON mutation.SAMPLE_ID = sample.INTERNAL_ID INNER JOIN patient ON sample.PATIENT_ID = patient.INTERNAL_ID INNER JOIN cancer_study ON patient.CANCER_STUDY_ID = cancer_study.CANCER_STUDY_ID

INNER JOIN sample ON structural_variant.SAMPLE_ID = sample.INTERNAL_ID INNER JOIN patient ON sample.PATIENT_ID = patient.INTERNAL_ID INNER JOIN cancer_study ON patient.CANCER_STUDY_ID = cancer_study.CANCER_STUDY_ID

INNER JOIN sample ON sample_cna_event.SAMPLE_ID = sample.INTERNAL_ID INNER JOIN patient ON sample.PATIENT_ID = patient.INTERNAL_ID INNER JOIN cancer_study ON patient.CANCER_STUDY_ID = cancer_study.CANCER_STUDY_ID

(SELECT DISTINCT ANNOTATION_JSON FROM mutation
WHERE cancer_study.CANCER_STUDY_IDENTIFIER = #{studyId} AND ANNOTATION_JSON IS NOT NULL) UNION ALL (SELECT DISTINCT ANNOTATION_JSON FROM structural_variant
WHERE cancer_study.CANCER_STUDY_IDENTIFIER = #{studyId} AND ANNOTATION_JSON IS NOT NULL) UNION ALL (SELECT DISTINCT ANNOTATION_JSON FROM sample_cna_event
WHERE cancer_study.CANCER_STUDY_IDENTIFIER = #{studyId} AND ANNOTATION_JSON IS NOT NULL)

choose.when: SELECT CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS outerKey WHERE 1 = 0

SELECT DISTINCT outerEntry.`key` AS outerKey FROM (
) combinedAnnotations, LATERAL JSON_EACH(PARSE_JSON(ANNOTATION_JSON)) outerEntry
choose.otherwise:
SELECT DISTINCT JSON_UNQUOTE(outerKey) AS outerKey FROM (
) combinedAnnotations, json_table(json_keys(ANNOTATION_JSON), '$[*]' COLUMNS(outerKey JSON PATH '$')) t

choose.when: SELECT CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS innerKey, #{outerKey} AS outerKey WHERE 1 = 0

choose.otherwise:
SELECT DISTINCT JSON_UNQUOTE(innerKey) AS innerKey, #{outerKey} AS outerKey FROM (
) combinedAnnotations, json_table(json_keys(JSON_EXTRACT(ANNOTATION_JSON, CONCAT('$.', #{outerKey}))), '$[*]' COLUMNS(innerKey JSON PATH '$')) t

mapper.select:
SELECT outerKey, innerKey, COUNT(DISTINCT SAMPLE_ID) AS count FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT SAMPLE_ID, #{namespaceAttribute.outerKey} AS outerKey, #{namespaceAttribute.innerKey} AS innerKey FROM mutation
AND IS NOT NULL AND != 'null'
UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT SAMPLE_ID, #{namespaceAttribute.outerKey} AS outerKey, #{namespaceAttribute.innerKey} AS innerKey FROM structural_variant
AND IS NOT NULL AND != 'null'
UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT SAMPLE_ID, #{namespaceAttribute.outerKey} AS outerKey, #{namespaceAttribute.innerKey} AS innerKey FROM sample_cna_event
AND IS NOT NULL AND != 'null'
) combinedCounts GROUP BY outerKey, innerKey;

SELECT value, outerKey, innerKey, COUNT(DISTINCT SAMPLE_ID) AS count, COUNT(SAMPLE_ID) AS totalCount FROM ( SELECT AS value, #{outerKey} AS outerKey, #{innerKey} AS innerKey, SAMPLE_ID AS SAMPLE_ID FROM mutation
AND IS NOT NULL AND != 'null'
UNION ALL
SELECT AS value, #{outerKey} AS outerKey, #{innerKey} AS innerKey, SAMPLE_ID AS SAMPLE_ID FROM structural_variant
AND IS NOT NULL AND != 'null'
UNION ALL
SELECT AS value, #{outerKey} AS outerKey, #{innerKey} AS innerKey, SAMPLE_ID AS SAMPLE_ID FROM sample_cna_event
AND IS NOT NULL AND != 'null' ) combinedCounts GROUP BY value, outerKey, innerKey;
